title: Interior Regularity for Stable Solutions of Semilinear Elliptic Equations with Sign-Changing Nonlinearities
summary: We investigate interior regularity for stable solutions of the semilinear elliptic equation $-Δu=f(u)$ in an open set $Ω\subseteq \mathbb R^n$, where $f$ is locally Lipschitz and may change sign. We establish sharp interior Hölder estimates for stable classical solutions in every dimension $n\le 9$, thereby fully resolving a question raised by Cabré concerning interior regularity without the nonnegativity assumption on $f$.
